item.title: Las Vegas
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Starcraft Co., Ltd., Sierra Entertainment
  • 発売日: 1987-01
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: ラスベガス
  • 英語名: Las Vegas

别名

  • Softporn Adventure

あらすじ

Las Vegas is a Japan-exclusive graphical variant of Softporn Adventure, and hence can be seen as an earlier version of Leisure Suit Larry, which was released a few months later. The gameplay is, by and large, identical to the original text-only version, with the exception of a few adjustments made to the monetary system and a few commands handled slightly differently.
